verdict.rationale: Factory shows sessions/tasks are accessible across Droid CLI (terminal), IDE integrations (editor), and Factory App (web/browser), with 'Design mode' inline comments letting a user act on and redirect an in-progress diff, and Droid 'acts on the feedback in place.' However, there's no explicit documentation of a seamless real-time handoff mid-task (e.g., pausing an active agent run and resuming/steering it live across surfaces) — most evidence describes reviewing/diffing after delegation or starting new sessions rather than actively taking over a running task. missing for 10: explicit doc of live mid-task takeover/interrupt-and-redirect flow, cross-surface session continuity (start in terminal, take over in browser) with state transfer, independent/hands-on confirmation of this handoff working.
